A Mouth Ulcer That Doesn't Heal Could Be More Than Just a Sore

Most mouth ulcers heal naturally within 7–14 days. However, if an ulcer persists for more than two weeks, it should never be ignored. A persistent mouth ulcer may be an early warning sign of oral precancerous lesions or oral cancer, and early diagnosis can significantly improve treatment outcomes.

Warning signs include:
• A non-healing ulcer lasting more than two weeks
• Persistent pain or bleeding
• White (leukoplakia) or red (erythroplakia) patches in the mouth
• Hardening around the ulcer
• Difficulty chewing, swallowing, or speaking
• A lump in the mouth or neck
• Unexplained weight loss

A timely evaluation may include biopsy, histopathological examination, CT/MRI scans, ultrasonography, PET-CT, and FNAC to establish an accurate diagnosis and stage the disease.

My mother’s slip disc problem was completely cured without surgery, thanks to Dr. Mayur Sankhe’s Ayurvedic treatment.

In 2023, my mother started experiencing severe lower back pain. After consulting local doctors, we were told that she had a slip disc between L4 and L5. Further tests, including an MRI, confirmed that a nerve was getting compressed due to the slip disc, causing pain in her back and legs. At a reputed hospital in Jabalpur, doctors strongly advised surgery. Another specialist also gave the same opinion — that surgery was necessary.

However, I was hesitant to go for surgery and initially tried some Ayurvedic treatment locally in Sagar, which gave minor relief. Around this time, my sister in Mumbai told me about a well-known Ayurvedic doctor in Boisar— Dr. Mayur Sankhe. I spoke with him over the phone, and the confidence with which he said, “Your mother will be fine without surgery,” gave me hope.

I took my mother all the way to Mumbai — a journey of over 1200 kilometers — and started her treatment with Dr. Sankhe. Over 10–12 days, she underwent a series of Panchakarma therapies including Swedan, Snehan, Kati Basti, massage, and internal Ayurvedic medicines.

To my surprise and deep relief, my mother’s pain reduced significantly, and soon she was completely fine — without a single surgical procedure.

After almost two years, when a bit of pain returned, we once again consulted Dr. Sankhe. He repeated a customized Panchakarma and Ayurvedic medicine regimen — and once again, she was cured completely.

Dr. Mayur Sankhe is not just a doctor — he is a healer in the truest sense.
•	He listens to patients very patiently,
•	Gives proper time to understand the problem,
•	Has deep knowledge — both of classical Ayurveda and modern medical concepts,
•	And most importantly, he treats with a genuine intention to heal.

His treatment is highly effective, personalized, and very affordable.

I am truly grateful to him and wholeheartedly recommend Dr. Mayur Sankhe to anyone looking for authentic Ayurvedic treatment — especially for spine, joint, or nerve-related issues — without the fear of surgery or side effects of modern medicines.
